misconception_description: Student believes that it is unnecessary for loop variables to be explicitly initialized before the loop.

solutions.generated_code:
program JumlahHarmonik
kamus
  n, i : integer
  jumlah : real
algoritma
  input(n)
  jumlah <- 0
  i <- 0
  for i <- 1 to n do
    jumlah <- jumlah + 1 / i
  endfor
  output(jumlah)
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student rewrote the recursive solution as an iterative one using a for loop. Due to their misconception that loop variables must be explicitly initialized, they added `i = 0` before the for loop. This initialization is unnecessary since the for loop automatically manages the loop variable, but it doesn't cause any errors - the loop simply reassigns i to the values from range(n, 0, -1). The code produces correct results despite the unnecessary initialization.
